subject: Cross-exam dedup finding: keep advisory mode
body:
Read your dedup guardrail findings. Three duplicate signatures flagged: rp6-q3 vs rp5-q1, rp6-q7 vs rp1-q6, rp7-q2 vs rp1-q2.

Decision: keep advisory mode (do NOT set STRICT_DEDUP=1 in CI gate).

Rationale: These exams are used sequentially by one student (Kai). Kai has already completed RP1 and RP5. Seeing a structurally similar question in RP6/RP7 is not a meaningful duplicate risk — Kai won't memorize numeric answers across sessions. The dedup concern was about pattern recognition making answers guessable on the same sitting, not across separate study days.

Action: Flag these 3 to GR via inbox for awareness. If GR wants to rotate the values, great. If not, advisory mode is sufficient. Do not block CI.

Thank you for the guardrail — the tooling is useful for future exams.
